messages.subject: Problems installing RStan 2.6.0 on an Ubuntu workstation
parts:
If anyone has issues on Ubuntu, you might want to read through this email.


Daniel


---------- Forwarded message ----------
From:  Larry Hunsicker
Date: Thu, Jun 4, 2015 at 1:25 PM
Subject: Problems installing RStan 2.6.0 on an Ubuntu workstation
To: Daniel Lee <bea...@alum.mit.edu>


Dan:

I just (finally) successfully installed RStan 2.6.0 on my Ubuntu 14.04.2 LTS workstation, using the corrected script that you just distributed.  But it was a bit of a struggle due to missing Ubuntu packages.  I was finally able, by checking the various error messages, to figure out the additional Ubuntu packages that I had to install before trying to install RStan in my R.  The problems appeared to be due to various files needed for the installation script to install RCurl successfully.

I had to install the following Ubuntu packages for the installation to work correctly:  libxml2-dev and libssl-dev.

Bear in mind that I am a statistician, not a developer.  I had never had a need to install these Ubuntu packages previously, but they are evidently needed to be able to install the R package RCurl and a couple of other packages that are dependent on RCurl.

You may want to add these requirements to your listing of the prerequisites listed under "Prerequisites for installing RStan/Toolchain/For Linux" on the RStan Quick Start Guide, in addition to the requirements for build-essential and g++ or clang++.

Thanks to you and to the rest of the STAN team for STAN and RSTAN.

Larry Hunsicker
